early_stop_reason: Published prior theorem exactly matches all original parameters and objective after taking the boundary complement
completion_scope: Prior-source identification and authored normalization/value packet; independent audit pending

repository_observation.duplicate_result: No existing target attempt identified in bounded repository checks
repository_observation.limits: Bounded repository checks, not exhaustive proof of absence across private chats, deleted refs or unindexed historical files.
repository_observation.recursive_tree_check: A whole-repository recursive tree request failed with Transport closed; no complete recursive-tree coverage is claimed

statement_normalization.directions: p distinct angles modulo 2 pi; permutations irrelevant
statement_normalization.domain: unit disk minus the radial segments [r,1] at these directions
statement_normalization.objective: harmonic measure of the outer circle at 0
statement_normalization.minimizers: equally spaced directions, up to rotation
statement_normalization.boundary_limits: ell=0 gives uncut disk; ell=1 excludes 0 and is not an allowed evaluation

safe_packet_scope: Authored mathematics and code, bibliographic/provenance metadata; excludes source texts, source PDFs, dataset records and corpus contents
remaining_step: Fresh independent mathematical/source audit before any authorized repository publication
